project.name: nautilus-compass
project.description: Nautilus Compass core memory engine: BGE-m3 vector recall, drift detection, metamemory self-knowledge, session memory + integrity, governance/feedback, and an MCP interface.

nodes.name: recall.py
nodes.summary: UserPromptSubmit hook · real BGE-m3 vector recall: embed prompt, top-k cosine memory hits + age grouping; pkl embedding cache. Core memory retrieval entrypoint.

nodes.name: recall_consumption.py
nodes.summary: Detects 'recall fired but not consumed' drift: a path surfaced in a recall block but never read; emits a consumption warning.

nodes.name: session_writer.py
nodes.summary: Stop-hook session writer (replaces claude-mem): parses last turns, distills to markdown obs via LLM, writes session_*.md, updates merkle chain + strategy store.

nodes.name: session_search.py
nodes.summary: Cross-project session memory search over session_*.md: keyword + drift + type filter, ranked by mtime.

nodes.name: cloud_ingest.py
nodes.summary: Pushes local session_*.md to cloud /v1/v14/ingest_obs over SSH for cross-dialog recall visibility (BGE index on cloud).

nodes.name: daemon.py
nodes.summary: BGE daemon: keeps the embedding model hot, serves recall/drift over TCP JSON IPC (127.0.0.1:9876); lifecycle tier promotion + query rewrite.

nodes.name: daemon_anchor_apply.py
nodes.summary: Applies layered anchors (platform_base + domain + tenant) to the daemon BGE index via patch mode without editing daemon core.

nodes.name: daemon_anchor_loader.py
nodes.summary: Loads & merges 3 anchor layers (platform_base / domain / tenant) into positive+negative anchor lists for the BGE index.

nodes.name: drift_history.py
nodes.summary: Drift timeline: ASCII visualization of AI drift history across sessions (which session began deviating from intent).

nodes.name: output_drift.py
nodes.summary: Assistant-output-side drift detection: language/style/persona drift over the session's assistant reply sequence (black-box, embedding-based).

nodes.name: contract.py
nodes.summary: Cross-agent contract schema + scanner: parse contracts from session frontmatter, ledger append, alert on overdue handoffs (close_loop).

nodes.name: feedback.py
nodes.summary: Adaptive anchor learning CLI: list/log/stats/retrain — consumes feedback.jsonl (tp/fp signals) to regenerate adapted drift anchors.

nodes.name: strategy_store.py
nodes.summary: Strategy store: DPT-Agent distilled reasoning paths persisted across sessions (strategies.jsonl).

nodes.name: numeric_claims.py
nodes.summary: Anti-hallucination numeric-claims hook: extract numeric claims on write, cross-ref on recall to surface conflicting old vs new numbers.

nodes.name: merkle_chain.py
nodes.summary: Local stdlib Merkle hash chain over session_*.md for tamper-evidence; verify_chain detects edits/deletions/additions.

nodes.name: query_rewrite.py
nodes.summary: Opt-in Gemini query rewrite before retrieval (expand abbreviations/synonyms); all LLM contact isolated here; falls back to original query.

nodes.name: mcp_server.py
nodes.summary: MCP JSON-RPC server (stdio) exposing recall / drift_check / feedback_log to MCP clients; backed by the TCP BGE daemon.

nodes.name: mcp_client.py
nodes.summary: MCP JSON-RPC client with automatic reconnect for long-lived A2A sessions (transparent retry on link drop).

nodes.name: poi_snapshot_cache.py
nodes.summary: Lazy mtime-cached PoI credit snapshot for the daemon boost path; never raises, degrades to last-good dict.

nodes.name: poi_weighting.py
nodes.summary: PoI weighting: boosts/demotes recall rank by cumulative_impact (asymptotic, capped, pure arithmetic, no LLM).

nodes.name: act_log.py
nodes.summary: Drift alert ack writer+reader: records acks against daemon alert_ids so act-on rate becomes computable (closes drift loop).

nodes.name: auto_ack.py
nodes.summary: Stop-hook auto-detection of drift-alert acknowledgements in session text (rule-based, no LLM); writes acks via act_log.

nodes.name: firing.py
nodes.summary: Drift firing decision: multi-signal vote (strong/weak score + neg-anchor hit) replacing the old high-FP OR-vote.

nodes.name: gate_act.py
nodes.summary: Act-stage drift gate: analyzes PoI events post-action for drift/stale-memory signals (logged-only).

nodes.name: routing.py
nodes.summary: Drift-as-routing: classify ingest tier (green canonical / yellow caveat / red quarantine) by drift score.

nodes.name: builder.py
nodes.summary: build_recall_result: glue turning recall match dicts into a metamemory RecallResult (confidence + source trail + gaps); pluggable LLM backend.

nodes.name: calibration.py
nodes.summary: Calibration scoring: how well reported confidence matches actual correctness (2-bucket).

nodes.name: confidence.py
nodes.summary: ConfidenceVector primitive: per-match confidence with deterministic monotonic composite scoring.

nodes.name: gap.py
nodes.summary: GapStatement primitive: compass surfacing 'I do not have evidence for X'.

nodes.name: gap_detector.py
nodes.summary: Gap detection: emits GapStatement when no match exceeds confidence threshold (anti hallucinate-absence).

nodes.name: result.py
nodes.summary: RecallResult: upgraded recall API returning matches + confidence + gaps + source trail.

nodes.name: auth.py
nodes.summary: Auth + quota middleware: X-Agent-Key (platform JWT) authentication, FastAPI dependency, psycopg tenant lookup.

nodes.name: gemini_flash.py
nodes.summary: Opt-in Gemini 2.5 Flash judge (COMPASS_USE_GEMINI_FLASH=1); preserves no-LLM-at-ingest default; used by query rewrite + benchmark judging.

nodes.name: recall
nodes.summary: Core recall function: embeds the prompt, returns top-k cosine memory hits with age grouping.

nodes.name: promote_lifecycle_tier
nodes.summary: Promotes a memory's lifecycle tier (archived flag); reused by daemon for arithmetic tiering.

nodes.name: should_fire_drift
nodes.summary: Multi-signal drift firing vote returning whether to raise a drift alert.

nodes.name: Contract
nodes.summary: Cross-agent contract dataclass (id, giver, deliverable, deadline) parsed from session frontmatter.

nodes.name: RecallResult
nodes.summary: Upgraded recall result carrying matches, confidence, gaps and source trail.

nodes.name: ConfidenceVector
nodes.summary: Per-match confidence vector with monotonic composite scoring.

nodes.name: GapStatement
nodes.summary: Statement that compass lacks evidence for a query (anti hallucinate-absence).

nodes.name: Tenant
nodes.summary: Authenticated tenant context (agent identity + quota) resolved from X-Agent-Key.

nodes.name: rewrite_query
nodes.summary: Opt-in query rewrite via Gemini Flash judge; returns original query on any fault.

layers.name: Memory Recall
layers.description: BGE-m3 vector recall, query rewrite, PoI rank boosting and recall consumption auditing — the core retrieval path.

layers.name: Session Memory & Sync
layers.description: Writing, searching, integrity-chaining and cloud-syncing of session memory files.

layers.name: Daemon Runtime & Anchors
layers.description: Hot BGE daemon TCP service and the layered-anchor loader/applier that configure its index.

layers.name: Drift Detection
layers.description: Input/output/persona drift detection, firing vote, routing, act-stage gating, ack telemetry and history.

layers.name: Metamemory / Self-Knowledge
layers.description: Confidence vectors, gap detection, calibration and RecallResult assembly so the subject LLM knows what compass does/doesn't know.

layers.name: Governance, Contracts & Feedback
layers.description: Cross-agent contracts/handoff ledger and the adaptive anchor feedback (PoI) learning loop.

layers.name: MCP Interface
layers.description: JSON-RPC MCP server/client exposing recall, drift and feedback to external agents.

layers.name: Recall Quality Gate
layers.description: Auth/quota middleware and the opt-in LLM judge guarding recall/retrieval quality.
